from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitation(BaseModel):
    """A parsed record for a single paper, capturing its identity and what it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper being parsed")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of papers referenced in this document's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitation]
